These pinned browser distributions are served locally so dashboard startup does
not depend on CDN availability. License notices are retained in each file.

- React 18.2.0: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/react/18.2.0/umd/react.production.min.js
- React DOM 18.2.0: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/react-dom/18.2.0/umd/react-dom.production.min.js
- Babel standalone 7.23.2: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/babel-standalone/7.23.2/babel.min.js
